decision thread for repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager

2026-11-22T03:36Z · **Maintainer ruling: who may see the automations in the stage-change confirm (the product decision this card asks for before build).**

## 维护者速读

- 问题：改阶段的确认框要从「可能触发相关自动化」换成具体清单，先要定普通用户能看到哪些自动化的名字。
- 裁定 A：能改这条记录的人，都在确认框里看到会触发的流程名称。
- 只给名称，带审批的标出；不给条件和细节；后台代码规则不列。
- 逐流程隐藏开关、只给数量、只给管理员这三种做法都不取。

## Ruling

- Asked on a decision card in the project (decision thread for seat repo:objectstack#4), question verbatim: 「定一下：改阶段的确认框里，谁能看到会触发的自动化名称？」
- Chosen option, verbatim: 「A 能改的人都看到名称」, picked by the maintainer (Leehom) in the app at 2026-11-22T03:36:19Z.
- Consequence shown on the card, verbatim: 「能改这条记录的人在确认框看到会触发的流程名称，带审批的标出；不给条件和细节，后台代码规则不列。」
- Options not taken: B (A plus a per-flow "do not show in the confirm" switch), C (ordinary users see a count only, administrators see names), D (only administrators see the list).

## As ruled

- The list holds flows only. A flow that contains an approval node is marked as starting an approval (ADR-0019: an approval is a node inside a flow). Hooks are not listed (ADR-0077 §2: the not-business-facing tier; they run on every save, whatever the stage).
- What is shown per flow: its display label, translated as labels are. No description, no condition, no nodes, no link for an ordinary user. A caller who may enter the design surfaces may get a way to open the flow.
- Who is answered: a caller who can read that record. No new capability and no new authorable key.
- Which flows: enabled ones whose start condition holds for the proposed change.
- A failed read or an empty list falls back to today's sentence, as the card's acceptance already says.

## Basis

- Governing text: ADR-0077 §2 (flows are the business-legible tier, hooks are not); ADR-0019; the type-level read table `STORED_METADATA_TYPE_READ_CAPABILITIES` (`packages/metadata-core/src/stored-metadata-type-read-admission.ts`), which lists `datasource` and `external_catalog` only, so a published flow's label is already part of what the `/meta` read doors serve a signed-in member. Read from the code on main `c30ce97c`; not measured against a running app with a member account. The builder re-checks it before any edit and reports a fork if it does not hold.
- The candidate "only the flows and approvals the user may already view" was not a separate option: the platform has no per-flow view permission (`requiredPermissions` on a flow governs who may start it), so it reads the same as A today.
- Protocol: Clause-② yes (widening: one new public read). Metadata-protocol: none.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A keeps the new read on the audience the metadata read doors already serve; C and D would give the screen and the door two audiences; B adds a protocol key.
② 实际业务拉动: the people changing a stage are ordinary users (ruling 7039615827 item 2 on #35685); nobody has asked for a hide switch.
③ 防 AI 犯错: A answers in one shape; C answers in two; B adds a key that leaks silently when it is missed.
④ 创业阶段不扩散: one read; no new key, no new capability.
Prior rulings read: "automation visibility", "flow names members", "which automations will fire" → 0 hits beyond this card and 7039615827; ADR-0077 §2, ADR-0019; thread: none

Self-check: by ① alone the choice is A; ②③④ do not flip it.

Dispatch stays with the seat: server half and UI half, size M as triaged, contract review before landing.
